summary: Iteration 16: open-ended itemizer + dashboard custom pricing. test_open_ended.py 9/9 passed. I triaged all 16 listed old failures. All 16 were obsolete expectations under the new spec (P0 must-ask before pricing, new labels/wording, 50 rules, new camera-only sink_type fact), and I updated each one to the new spec. While doing that I found 2 real regressions and added tests that reproduce them. I added tests/test_iteration16_custom_pricing.py (4 tests): validation, rate-card reuse, P0 gating, if_not in the PDF. Final run of 79 tests: 75 passed, 4 failed. 3 of the failures are real bugs. The 4th, test_fix7_camera_speed, is flaky: it passed in the first 2 runs and failed in the last 2 because Percia gave no finding within 90s. UI tested with Playwright, and everything requested works: drawer 'Needs your price', the price-custom form with 3 tiers -> toast -> priced quote v1, no SMS, the new task shows in Rate card Prices; Quotes-page custom line form -> v2; quote-if-not on the quote detail and the portal; the PDF contains the if_not sentence.

critical.issue: One 'not sure' to a P0 (must-ask) fact counts as 3 unknowns, so the P0 is defaulted on the FIRST 'not sure' instead of being asked again (spec: after two). RCA: turn() runs `for _ in range(3): iz.apply_answers(answers, ...)` and each pass does f['unknowns'] += 1. Repro: 'I want to take out the tiles' then {tile_replacement:'not sure'} -> resolved with basis 'unsure', unknowns=3. Fix: call apply_answers once per turn (keep splits/rules in the loop) or make the unknown count idempotent per turn. Test: test_call_fixes.py::test_p0_single_not_sure_reasks

'replace the glass with a small elegant one' is mapped by the LLM to BOTH glass_panel_removal and partition_check (cached in itemizer_llm_cache). Alex then asks 'Is it a full wall, a shorter divider, or the glass by the shower?' even though the homeowner said glass. Because of the bug above, one 'not sure' defaults it to 'full wall', which splits into Wall removal + Patch and paint ceiling + Patch floor + structural permit plus the floor_above/wall_central questions (+$3,000-$10,000 on the quote). RCA: the drop logic in clause_hits (partition_check/glass_panel_removal drop wall_removal) only runs on trigger hits, not on the LLM ids, and nothing drops partition_check when glass_panel_removal is present. Fix: post-filter LLM ids through the same overlap rules (glass_panel_removal present -> drop partition_check). Also consider not splitting partition_check into wall_removal on an 'unsure' answer. Test: test_call_fixes.py::test_glass_clause_never_adds_wall_removal

Pricing a custom line saves a new priced quote even when other jobs still have open P0 facts (seen: finish_level, wall_replacement, wall_length, wall_floor_finish). iz.price() fills in their defaults, which breaks the 'P0 never defaulted' rule. The quote is saved with status 'sent' when the lead is not in a call. Fix: in price_custom only call save_itemized when not iz.p0_open(); otherwise just update the rate card and session (quote_id null). Test: test_iteration16_custom_pricing.py::test_price_custom_respects_open_p0

minor.issue: Scope gets dropped when a trigger matches a location word. 'I want to put in a small koi pond by the window' -> only 'Windows' is added and the koi pond is lost (no Apex line), because the clause had a trigger hit so neither the LLM nor add_custom ran. This breaks 'never drop scope'.

Custom clause text is not cleaned. Alex says 'About the I want to add a small sauna in the corner: what's coming out, if anything?' and 'I've noted I want to add ...'. The line label is 'To be priced by Apex: I want to add a small sauna in the corner'. Strip leading 'I want to / I'd like to / can you' and the article.

drivers lists the unpriced 'To be priced by Apex: ...' line as the first driver. For the wall job, drivers = [Wall removal $2,500, Patch ceiling, Patch floor] and leaves out the largest line, Engineer and beam allowance ($6,800).

The new camera-only sink_type fact (default 'vanity cabinet') on Remove vanity adds 'Assumed sink type: vanity cabinet' even when it doesn't change the price. This widens range_pct by 5% (Remove vanity alone: 15% instead of 10%).

There is no duplicate check on match words: two dashboard-priced tasks can both trigger on 'sauna' (seen: TEST_ Corner sauna + TEST_ Living room sauna). The new task is also locked to the lead's room, so a sauna priced on a living-room lead won't match in a bathroom.

Flaky, failed 2 of 4 runs: no camera finding within 90s. Each clip now carries 5 goals (survey + sinks + vanity_mount + sink_type + water_damage). Percia keeps polling but there is no goal.completed in time. Check Percia latency now that the survey goal is in the batch.

Real lead Dhivya Vijayakumar has quote v1 $0 'sent' (14:24, from before the fix) with only 'To be priced by Apex: change the mirrors'. The homeowner portal shows a $0 quote. I did not touch it; recall it or re-price it.

action_items: Fix the triple-counted P0 'not sure' in engine.turn (apply_answers runs 3x per turn)
Apply the overlap/drop rules to LLM-mapped ids: glass_panel_removal must drop partition_check and wall_removal. Don't escalate an 'unsure' partition answer to a full wall removal
price_custom: don't save or send a quote while p0_open() is non-empty
Don't drop scope when the only trigger hit is a location noun (e.g. 'by the window'): send such clauses to the LLM or add an Apex line
Clean the custom clause wording ('About the I want to add ...')
Drivers: rank by amount and leave out unpriced custom lines
Make the drawer tier inputs wide enough for 5-digit prices
Optional: skip the assumption/range penalty for zero-impact camera-only facts (sink_type); recall the stale $0 quote on the real lead Dhivya
critical_code_review_comments: engine.py is 936 lines (>700): split out next_action/P0 logic, pricing/scenario and the survey/custom handlers
turn(): 'for _ in range(3): apply_answers' has side effects (unknowns, skips, confirmed) that are not idempotent. Only the splits/rules need the fixed-point loop
LLM results bypass the clause_hits drop rules, so overlapping tasks are possible from the LLM path

price_custom builds task triggers from words with re.escape plus \b, so a multi-word phrase gets an escaped space ('\bsteam\ room\b'). It works, but there is no check for collisions with existing triggers
Existing test modules (test_itemizer/test_itemizer_fixes/test_call_fixes) still call /api/kb/reset in teardown, which goes against the 'avoid kb/reset' note. I left them unchanged

rca of the issue: P0 unknown triple count: engine.turn loops apply_answers 3x per turn -> unknowns reaches 3 -> resolve(default,'unsure') on the first 'not sure'. Glass -> wall removal: the LLM maps the glass clause to [glass_panel_removal, partition_check]; partition_kind 'not sure' -> default 'full wall' -> split adds wall_removal plus rules (ceiling patch, floor patch, permit, load-bearing clue questions). price_custom: it calls iz.price() + save_itemized unconditionally and never checks iz.p0_open().
